title: sanguisorba minor subsp. rupicola
intro: Sanguisorba minor subsp. rupicola, commonly known as Alpine Burnet, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, known for its distinctive red flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support digestive health and reduce inflammation, showcasing its potential in alleviating symptoms of gastrointestinal issues such as diarrhea and dyspepsia. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect the body from oxidative stress and promote wound healing. Sanguisorba minor subsp. rupicola contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
